Name: (AT) Golden Girls Furniture
Author: MossiMods
Description:
[center][color=#e06666][b][size=6][font=Georgia]Description[/font][/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ea9999][b][size=4]Alternative Texture Mod for the Furniture Catalogue that adds Furniture, Floors, and Wallpapers based on the Furniture, Floors, and Wallpapers from the  beloved TV show "The Golden Girls" Which Golden Girl is your favorite? [/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ea9999][b][size=4]You can now add their style to your Farmhouse![/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#6d9eeb][b][size=4]NOTE:[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][color=#6d9eeb][b][size=4]This is a FREE Mod that I uploaded to Nexusmods ONLY.[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][color=#6d9eeb][b][size=4]If you see it anywhere else, please let me know.[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][color=#cc0000][b][size=4]**NO AI USED TO CREATE MY MODS**[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url][/color]
you can hit "I" on your keyboard  to spawn the piece of furniture you want right away, without the catalogue, 
then use the Paint Bucket Tool (which you can also spawn using the CJB Item Spawner) to change its Texture! 

Use the paint bucket on floors and walls to change the textures for them as well.

But if you'd like to work for the catalogue, The [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] can be purchased at the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Carpenter%27s_Shop]Carpenter's Shop[/url] for [img width=18,height=18]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/18px-Gold.png[/img]200,000g, after upgrading the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Farmhouse]farmhouse[/url]. It can also be purchased from [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Robin]Robin[/url]'s shop at the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Desert_Festival]Desert Festival[/url] for [img width=24,height=24]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/d/da/Calico_Egg.png/24px-Calico_Egg.png[/img] 1,000.
Once placed, [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/File:Right-Click.png][img width=24,height=24]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/e/e2/Right-Click.png/24px-Right-Click.png[/img][/url] on the furniture catalogue allows the player to purchase many [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture]furniture[/url] items for [img width=18,height=18]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/18px-Gold.png[/img]0g in unlimited quantity. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Download the two required mods: [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/u] and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]   
2. Download this mod, unzip it and put it into your Stardew Valley Mods Folder


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Decorate your home with The Golden Girls Style![/color][/size]

[color=#e06666][size=5][b]ITEMS:[/b][/size][/color]
Queen of the Gem Sea  -- Leaves for top of Blanche's Bed (place on wall above bed)
Double Bed -- All the Golden Girls' Beds
Red Armchair -- All the Golden Girls' Bedroom Chairs
Red Couch -- Rose's Bedroom Sofas [color=#6d9eeb](for some reason when you sit on these,the bottom of the couch [/color]
[color=#6d9eeb]appears above the player's head, I can't figure out how to fix it)[/color]
Oak Dresser -- Blanche's Green Makeup Table
Birch Lamp End Table -- All the Golden Girls' Bedroom Bedside Lamps
Artist Bookcase -- Bedroom Dressers ( only actually in Sophia's room in the show, but I added more as filler)
Houseplant (any) -- Blanche's and Sophia's Decorative Grass Vases
Sconce (any) -- All the Golden Girls' Bedroom Sconces 
Dancing Grass -- Rose's Bedroom Wall Painting
Futan Bear -- Rose's one-eared childhood bear, Fernando
Birch End Table -- Sophia's Magazine Basket
Diviner Table -- Round Kitchen Tables with Table Cloth
Birch Table -- The "Island" table 
Little Tree -- Hanging Decorative Copper Lobster Mold for Kitchen [color=#ff7700](Big - to show detail..)[/color]
A Night on Eco-Hill -- Hanging Decorative Copper Fish and Chicken Molds for Kitchen [color=#ff7700](Big - to show detail)[/color]
Large Brown Couch -- Living Room Couch
Blossom Rug -- Living Room Rug
Flooring and Wallpapers also included! 
* No copyright infringement of The Golden Girls intended.*

I highly recommend the many other wonderful furniture, rug, painting, and houseplant mods here on nexusmods to add to
your rooms with! I have tons of them in my game <3 Thank you to the many, many talented Mod Creators here who make
this cozy game fit everyone's own personal aesthetics so well!
